Subject: Warm handoff — CedarBridge inbound signup (pilot)

Hi team,

Quick handoff: CedarBridge signed up via self-serve last week and requested a short pilot focused on private deployment (VPC + KMS). I spoke with Evan earlier — their goals are:
- Evaluate VPC-onboarding workflow and KMS key integration
- Validate audit/logging and retention settings for compliance
- Confirm network requirements and an IP allowlist process

Evan and Maya are CedarBridge IT/security (CC'd). They asked for AE + SE presence and prefer a short architecture walkthrough plus a demo of the Dedicated/Private options.

Suggesting Mina to take AE lead, Karhtik for commercial context, Alex as SE, and Soojin for security escalation if needed. Customer is in US Eastern (NY) — they prefer afternoons ET.

Next steps: can the team propose 2–3 60-minute windows next week (Mon–Thu) that work for AE+SE? I'll push the Calendly link for booking but would rather align internal availability first.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/30min-demo?ref=cedarbridge

Thanks,
Jasmine
--
Jasmine Liu
SDR, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com

Thanks Jasmine — looping in the AE/SE crew.

- Tue, Jun 22 — 11:00 AM ET (08:00 AM PT)
- Wed, Jun 23 — 2:00 PM ET (11:00 AM PT)
- Thu, Jun 24 — 4:00 PM ET (01:00 PM PT)

If none of those work for CedarBridge, call out preferred ranges and we can shift. Alex — can you confirm you can cover the Private deployment flow for any of those slots? Also tagging Soojin for security questions (audit logs, KMS).

I attached a short pre-demo checklist to share with the customer (network/IP asks + what we demo).

- Evan said they prefer afternoons ET but avoid late afternoons on Thu (internal maintenance window).

If possible, prioritize Tue 11:00 AM ET or Wed 2:00 PM ET. I'll prepare a short contract snapshot for the call. I've also pasted the Calendly link for the customer to choose a slot if we publish the times: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/30min-demo?ref=cedarbridge

Thanks for the quick handoff and the checklist, team. A couple constraints from IT:
- We have a maintenance blackout on Thu afternoons ET, so Thu 4pm ET is out.
- We prefer not to schedule before 10:30 AM ET due to daily standups.
- For the demo, please provide an IP allowlist (we'll add to our firewall). I'm attaching our internal CSV template we use for allowlists.

Preferred windows for us (in ET):
- Tue Jun 22 — 2:00 PM–4:00 PM ET
- Wed Jun 23 — 11:00 AM–2:00 PM ET

If you need a brief 15-min tech pre-check to confirm access paths, we can carve out 15 minutes prior to the demo.

Evan

Director IT, CedarBridge Health
evon.brooks@cedarbridge.com

Hi Evan — appreciate the constraints. I can cover the Private deployment flow and KMS integration. Two quick asks so the demo is productive:
1) Can you share the firewall allowlist CSV with the public IPs that will be used for the demo session (we typically host from a small pool of egress IPs)? If you prefer, send the CSV and we'll populate the fields we need.
2) I'd like a 15-minute tech check 30 minutes before the demo to validate routing and permissions (we'll only need Mina + one IT contact).

If Tue Jun 22 2:00 PM ET fits for everyone, I propose we set the tech check at 1:30 PM ET that day. I've attached a short SE checklist for the pre-check.

Thanks,
Alex

- Evan / Maya: please confirm you can add the Redwood egress IPs to your allowlist (I attached the IP list below and Jasmine will push an invite once we get confirmation).
